adjacent_repo_findings.finding: General NZ government YouTube metadata archival exists, but local evidence did not show a complete official NZ Parliament YouTube or Parliament website video archive.
HathiTrust-side work covers historical print/OCR evidence, not Parliament video.
Legislation and Gazette boundaries are adjacent but do not provide Parliament video coverage.

next_actions: Create a metadata-only seed fetcher for the official NZ Parliament YouTube channel.
Create metadata probes for videos.parliament.nz and the previous On Demand site.
Inventory select committee archive and Vimeo-era links before any media-file acquisition decision.
Run a rights review before video download, transcript extraction, or public media publication.
